meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: 装上后,你说出触发词,Claude 会进入 Hyperplan 模式:组建 5 名互相敌对的评审成员,让它们互相攻击各自的发现,只保留经得住批评的结论,再交给 plan 助手写成可执行的计划。
howto.when: 当你说出“hyperplan”“hpp”“/hyperplan”等关键词,或要求做对抗式/交叉批评式规划时触发。还要求已开启团队模式。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 给我出一版最严格的上线计划。
say.note: 会启动 5 人对抗评审并产出正式计划。

say.text: hpp 评审一下这个重构方案,专挑隐藏耦合。
say.note: 五个成员会交叉攻击,留下经得起反驳的结论。

say.text: adversarial plan:找找我的迁移计划里最脆弱的假设。
say.note: 将自动进入对抗规划流程。

howto.what_en: On install, a trigger word makes Claude start Hyperplan mode: it assembles 5 hostile reviewers who attack each other's findings, keeps only the survivors, and passes them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say keywords like 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', or ask for adversarial/cross-critique planning. Team mode must be enabled.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to give me the strictest launch plan.
say_en.note: Starts the 5-person adversarial review and produces a formal plan.

say_en.text: hpp: critique this refactoring, hunt for hidden coupling.
say_en.note: Five members cross-attack; only defensible conclusions remain.

say_en.text: adversarial plan: find the weakest assumptions in my migration plan.
say_en.note: Automatically enters the adversarial planning flow.
